KDWP camping page, Wayback capture of 2025-10-28 (https://web.archive.org/web/20251028091024/https://ksoutdoors.gov/Services/Outdoor-Activities/Camping), read 2026-11-06: 'Camping at State Fishing Lakes & Wildlife Areas - All campers and camping units at state fishing lakes or wildlife areas are limited to designated camping areas and a stay of not more than seven consecutive days on that department managed land unless otherwise established by posted notice or authorized by written permit from the department.'; 'Not all state fishing lakes and wildlife areas allow camping. values.note: Seven consecutive nights at a state fishing lake, then five days away; one extension of up to seven more nights by written permit from KDWP if sites are vacant (K.A.R. 115-8-9(c), amended 2023).

facilities.source: KDWP Geary SFL page (Wayback 2026-07-11): 'Vault Toilet ... Double vault toilet', read 2026-11-06

note: KDWP state fishing lake and wildlife area 10 mi south of Junction City off US 77; free primitive camping in designated areas by the 99-acre lake, with picnic shelters (several with fire-ring grills) through the camping area, a boat ramp at the southeast corner and a double vault toilet. Gravel drive-in access. Busy in summer (a June 2026 camper found every site full). --Claude
summary: KDWP SFL page (Wayback 2026-07-11) + KDWP camping page confirm free, FCFS, designated camping areas, vault toilet; max stay is 7 nights at state fishing lakes since K.A.R. 115-8-9 was amended in 2023 (was stored 14). Pin is in the water ~45 m off the east shore; lakeview kept. Phone confirmed.
flags: MAX STAY 14 -> 7: since 2023-04-21 K.A.R. 115-8-9(c) limits camping at a state fishing lake or wildlife area to seven consecutive days (extendable seven more by permit), and KDWP's camping page says the same. The stored 14 (and the note's '14-day limit') came from note prose. OTHER KS FISHING-LAKE ENTRIES likely carry 14 too (Ottawa SFL 2089 was given 14 from its own page's 'Fourteen days maximum per stay', which is a posted notice and may stand); worth a sweep of ownership state + 'State Fishing Lake' in KS.

PIN MOVE: stored 38.8968,-96.8554 is in the lake, ~45 m off the east shore in the mouth of the southeast cove (Esri 2026-11-06). The camping area's shelters are in two groups by the east shore: the boat-ramp/picnic loop just north (~38.8978,-96.8555, KDWP's ramp coordinate) and a gravel loop with shelters south of the cove (~38.8961,-96.8549). Proposed pin 38.8961,-96.8549 (the south loop, ~100 m from the stored pin); KDWP gives no campsite map, so which loop holds most of the camping is not certain.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (no change). Neither shelter loop's pads are legible at the shoreline: the south loop's west road runs ~25-40 m from a marshy cove edge with grass and trees between, the ramp loop has picnic shelters and the ramp lot (day use) between it and the water. Open view of the lake from both. Lake 99 acres (not a pond).
FISHING-LAKE DESIGNATED CAMPING: designated camping areas with shelters and fire rings, and a camper found 'every site was full' (6/2026), so state (not wma) stands.
PHONE 785-461-5402 confirmed (KDWP page: Milford Wildlife Area; Google Maps). WEBSITE as stored (KDWP page, 403 to plain HTTP; Wayback copy current to July 2026). No booking link: not reservable.
HOOKUPS/potable water left as stored (derived): the current KDWP page does not mention water or electric; a 2022 RV Life camper reports 'no electric and no water'.
SAND: none (grass and gravel). No 4WD statement; ORVs and horses prohibited.
